note: Crawford County Conservation park east of Denison on Yellow Smoke Lake (the county gives 37 and 40 acres). The 61-site main campground has gravel pads among trees along the lake's north shore; the 15-site North Campground sits up the hill with its own comfort station. On-site resident host. Cabins, a boat ramp, an accessible fishing pier and a 4-mile paved trail. --Claude
summary: Fees $20, 14-night max, FCFS, 76 sites (61 + 15 North), water hookups, showers, dump and season (mid-April through October) confirmed from the county's mycountyparks pages; unsourced 55-ft max and pull-throughs cleared. Waterfront lead down to lakeview (paved shore trail between pads and lake). Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront -> lakeview): imagery shows the main campground's southern pads ~10-25 m from the lake, but a paved path runs along the shore between every pad and the water and crosses the lake arm on a footbridge - this looks like the park's '4 mile paved walking/biking trail', a day-use path (AWH 2026-11-01: the land between site and water must be open with no driveways or day use). The water is open and visible across short grass from those pads, so lakeview is supported. No official per-site photos found. The North Campground is ~150 m up the hill across the park road. Lake is 37-40 acres (county figures), well over the pond line.
